what: Earlier internal measurements (October 2026) of the Agate FCDM training loop (perf_kit/t2i/fcdm). Part A (loop_1node) ran on synthetic latents with LogoLabs' PRIVATE captions (not reproducible from this repository); part B (step_1gpu_synthetic) ran on synthetic inputs only (no private data), but its logs are not in this repository. Source: research notes 2026-10-10 / 2026-10-11.
model: Agate Preview 002 architecture (FCDM-T2, preset 'agate': 190,929,092 parameters), 256 px (32 x 32 x 4 latents), torch.compile on in every arm
gpu: NVIDIA GH200 120GB, 660 W module power cap
mfu_convention: torch FLOP counter on the uncompiled generator, forward + backward of one image, counted with --steer_upsample_once off (637.9 GFLOP per image in part B); text encoder not counted; 989 TFLOPS bf16 peak

loop_1node.what: the real training loop, 1 node x 4 GH200, 128 images per GPU, frozen text encoder, synthetic 32 x 32 latents with real (private) captions; steady state = median of the 25-step windows 100-225; each arm adds to the previous one

rows.arm: F1: + EMA foreach, DDP bucket view, DDP static graph

loop_1node.power: SM clock median 1,710 MHz (max 1,980), GPU 519 W median, software power cap in 81% of busy samples
loop_1node.ema_check: EMA foreach vs loop bit-identical on GH200 (579 tensors, max diff 0)

step_1gpu_synthetic.what: the training step alone, one GH200, compiled, synthetic latents and a synthetic 64-token text context, frozen text

lora_512_compile.what: context: torch.compile on a 512 px LoRA fine-tune of the Agate generator (private data; the LoRA recipe is not part of this repository)
